signal: Role-level hypothesis: as a new-ish CRO at NobleAI scaling a science-based AI platform post Series A, coverage outpaces a lean sales team

email.body1:
Ned, stepping into the CRO seat at NobleAI, you are likely seeing more in-market R&D accounts than a lean team can cover.

That is the classic early-scale squeeze: real demand for the Reactor platform, but not enough reps to work it before deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for NobleAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ned, quick follow-up for NobleAI.

As CRO, the board number on pipeline usually outruns what a small team can book. Most orgs cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NobleAI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps to close it.
email.body3:
Ned, last bit of proof for NobleAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NobleAI's reply rate likely compares to other technical-AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ned, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Building out a go-to-market motion is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to NobleAI either way.
